# CI Workflows

GitHub Actions workflows go here (lint/test/build pipelines, etc.).

- `pr.yml` — lint, typecheck, test, dependency scan, and a container image build on every pull request and on push to `main`. Runs on GitHub-hosted runners.
  - The **image job** exists because nothing in CI used to build the images at all, and `deploy-dev.yml` builds them only *after* a merge. Two drifted silently that way — `api.Dockerfile` stopped copying `packages/core` (five PRs), and `web.Dockerfile` served a placeholder long after `apps/web` was real (three sprints) — and both surfaced as a broken deploy of an already-merged commit.
  - It also **runs** the two real images, because building is not the same as working: the web placeholder built perfectly, and a missing workspace package fails at `require` time, not at `docker build` time. So the api image must resolve its whole boot graph *including* `@ostomy/core`, and the web image must serve a Vite-built bundle with a working SPA fallback. `admin` is built but not content-checked — it is a deliberate placeholder until `apps/admin` is scaffolded.
  - Its environment variables are obviously-fake non-secrets passed as process env, not a `.env` file. Compose demands them because every required value uses `${VAR:?...}`, even for `build`. `DEV_HOST_ADDRESS` is the only one that reaches an image (`web.Dockerfile` bakes the `VITE_*` args into the bundle), and a fake value is deliberate: it makes these images unservable, and they are discarded rather than pushed.
- `deploy-dev.yml` — **disabled, and has never run** (#76). No self-hosted runner is registered, so every job it queued on push to `main` waited forever — and a queued-forever job looks exactly like a slow one, which is how three merges shipped against a stale stack unnoticed. Its trigger is now `workflow_dispatch` only, so nothing claims to deploy; `docs/deployment-development.md` "Deploying by hand" is the current procedure and `scripts/dev-stack-status.sh` says whether it is needed. The file is retained because the sequence it encodes is correct. Originally: builds, migrates, deploys, and health-checks the shared on-premise development stack on push to `main`. Runs on the self-hosted runner (labels `self-hosted`, `linux`, `x64`, `ostomy-dev`) — see `docs/deployment-development.md` "Deployment pipeline" and "Runner operational notes". Does not itself lint, typecheck, or test — but it also has no `needs:`/`workflow_run:` dependency on `pr.yml`; both trigger independently on push to `main` and run concurrently. It assumes `pr.yml` already verified the commit being deployed; that assumption is enforced by branch protection on `main` (an organizational setting), not by anything in either workflow file.
